text:
About Us
01
Dedication
Regardless of how ordinary the task may appear, we continually strive to perform it better. Because of this, we consistently go above and beyond expectations, even with routine, low-stakes tasks. We bring the distinctive Akeo signature to everything we do. We attempt to improve everything we touch. "Is this the best it can be at this point in the project?" is a question we ask ourselves at every stage of the process.
02
Expertise
Integrating creative and technical expertise in the same company is challenging and rewarding. The resulting fully cross-functional multi-domain skill set and experience give us the confidence and nous to implement solutions for clients across various industries, company stages, and cultural contexts. This makes us versatile enough to meet almost every need.
03
Growth
While integrating creative and technical expertise into one company is challenging, it has given us extensive experience in providing solutions for various industries, global companies, and startups at all stages. This makes us versatile enough to meet almost every need. We encourage our employees to broaden their skill sets, boosting their productivity and confidence.
04
Impact
Every business is unique in terms of the context it serves the market and its customers. We tailor strategy and execution in alignment with the unique contexts of every one of our clients, big or small.Consequently, our clients can accomplish some of their most challenging objectives because they can count on our dedicated teams consistently bringing their A-game to deliver solutions with the most significant impact on business goals and customer satisfaction.
05
Teamwork
Teamwork is the secret to our success. Our planning, thinking, and decision-making is all centered on collaboration and cooperation. Our shared ideals drive us to pursue a vision of quality, experience, and value that we infuse into our partnerships. We provide our teams with all the tools they need to execute their tasks while encouraging them to be self-reliant and free to make their own decisions.

senior-designer
We're seeking a dynamic and talented Mid/Senior digital designer to join our vibrant interdisciplinary team. We value individuals who excel in both UX and UI, demonstrating strong visual design skills. We’re looking for a proactive problem solver with strong communication skills, who thrives in fast-paced collaboration and is always eager to learn and embrace new challenges.
Short Summary
‍
🕛 Full-time position
🏝️ Fully Remote (but you can work from our Serbian or Slovenian office)
🌟 Minimum 3+ years of digital design experience
🇬🇧 Native or Professional English is a must
🤑 Salary will be assessed according to your location and relevant experience
Key Responsibilities:
Develop a deep understanding of user and business goals to inform design strategy.
Tackle complex design challenges and provide creative solutions that balance user needs, business objectives, and technical constraints.
Conduct user research to understand user needs, behaviors, and pain points. Analyze data and feedback to inform design decisions.
Create wireframes, user flows, and interactive prototypes to visualize and communicate design concepts. Iterate on designs based on feedback and user testing.
Fluent with design systems and the ability to establish them from scratch
Develop innovative high-fidelity UX/UI/Interaction/Print designs that adhere to brand guidelines and design systems. Ensure consistency across all customer touchpoints.
Plan and conduct usability testing sessions to gather feedback and validate design decisions. Use insights to refine and enhance the user experience.
Ability to take ownership of projects and influence decision-making.
Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, engineers, and other designers.
Establishing design systems from scratch
What You Will Need
Proficient in industry-standard design tools (Figma, e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Google Workspace, Slack).
Strong understanding of web design principles, user experience (UX), and user interface (UI) design.
A solid foundation in visual design theory encompassing composition, color theory, and typography is highly valued at Akeo. We prioritize attitude over existing skills, recognizing the dynamic nature of our field. Adaptability is key, and we are open to exploring new processes that enhance productivity, efficiency, and overall satisfaction.
You have a minimum of 3 years of experience delivering exceptional interaction design for web and mobile platforms within startups, studios, or agencies, significantly influencing brand direction.
A strong command of design processes, methodologies, and principles, reflecting your passion for the art of design. Your focus on user experience and information architecture is a key asset.
Your portfolio should demonstrate a mastery of crafting beautiful, usable experiences across various devices and contexts.
BIG PLUS: Experience with animation tools such as Figma Prototype/After Effects/Rive and experience with 3D.
What we offer
High-end creative projects to work on!
Basic gross salary that depends on your experience, knowledge, talent, and agreement.
Up to 30% variable personal monthly reward for results above expectations.
Permanent employment with a trial period of 3 months.
Our standard workweek consists of 40 hours. Our agency operates between 9 am and 6 pm CET.
Unlock the chance for personal growth, increased ownership, and skill enhancement.
Cooperation with international teams.
Possibility to visit and work from our Slovenian/Serbian office.
Benefit from a training budget to pursue your interests, and count on our continuous support for your personal growth.
Hiring process @Akeo
Your application will be pre-selected based on your experiences, roles in specific projects, and skills.
You'll have a video call with the Akeo design lead, where you'll present a detailed look at one of your projects. Choose a project, tell us about your collaborators, the tools you used, and any challenges you encountered.
Short intro call w/ Akeo leadership.
Welcome to the team.
Please include a link to your portfolio showcasing relevant work samples. A portfolio submission is mandatory for consideration of your application.
Cheers! 🍻
‍
‍
Akeo is a team of multidisciplinary digital product experts specialized in Web Design, Branding, and Product Design. We extend the design, development, and marketing departments of international clients. With an insight-based approach and an emphasis on digital experiences, we partner with brands and deliver them side-to-side customized solutions and services. We craft communication, identity, strategies, and commerce by continually merging aesthetics with purpose.

text:
Lipica The Cradle Of The White Horses
The stories told by Lipica leave a lasting impression. Because they are one of a kind and written in the embrace of its beautiful estate. Every activity is steeped in a centuries-long tradition, and coloured with picturesque scenes of nature and marvellous images of white horses. The mission of the Lipica Stud Farm is to ensure prime services in the breeding of Lipizzan horses and equestrianism, as well as the protection, preservation, and development of the cultural and natural heritage and its promotion through advanced tourism products designed on the basis of harmony between horses, people, and nature.
‍
Their website did not showcase the complexity and vast array of possible activities and attractions visitors could participate in and see on the Lipica ground. They had a lot of unstructured content, and we made sure to modernize and refresh their website and make their content more accessible. In addition, we worked on easier access to the online ticket purchasing system.
markdown:
# Lipica The Cradle Of The White Horses

The stories told by Lipica leave a lasting impression. Because they are one of a kind and written in the embrace of its beautiful estate. Every activity is steeped in a centuries-long tradition, and coloured with picturesque scenes of nature and marvellous images of white horses. The mission of the Lipica Stud Farm is to ensure prime services in the breeding of Lipizzan horses and equestrianism, as well as the protection, preservation, and development of the cultural and natural heritage and its promotion through advanced tourism products designed on the basis of harmony between horses, people, and nature.

‍

Their website did not showcase the complexity and vast array of possible activities and attractions visitors could participate in and see on the Lipica ground. They had a lot of unstructured content, and we made sure to modernize and refresh their website and make their content more accessible. In addition, we worked on easier access to the online ticket purchasing system.

senior-web-developer
Tražimo Medior/Senior developere (2-5) sa dosta iskustva u WordPress-u, WooCommerce-u, Javascriptu i Reactu.
‍
Naša očekivanja:
Očekujemo da poseduješ dobar temelj opštih tehnologija za izradu web sajtova, osećaj za dizajn, debagovanje i rad u timu.
Očekujemo da imaš više od 3 godina iskustva u pravljenju web aplikacija i web sajtova.
Dobro razumevanje HTML, CSS (SCSS), Mobile first i Responsive development principa i metodologija.
Poznavanje frontend build alata (Grunt/Gulp, Webpack...).
Odlično poznavanje Javascripta, manipulacije DOMa i njenih dobrih optimizacionih praksi.
Jako znanje o WordPressu i PHPu.
Dobro poznavanje alata za kontrolu verzija koda (Git/GitHub).
Iskustvo u radu sa aplikacijama zasnovanim na API-ju kao i dobro znanje REST principa.
Dodatno je dobrodošlo da imaš:
Iskustvo u optimizovanju, održavanju i unapređenju performansi web sajtova.
Iskustvo u rešavanju Cross-browser i Cross-device compatibility problema.
Iskustvo u pisanju plaginova i tema za WordPress.
Planiranje i postavljanje projekta od početka do kraja.
Dodatan plus su još iskustva iz:
Rada sa ACF blokovima kao i sa Gutenberg blokovima.
Iskustvo sa React-om i Nextjs-om ili bilo koji drugi JavaScript frameworkom.
Iskustvo sa Shopify-jem ("custom built").
U našem timu očekujemo da imaš i:
Iskustvo komunikacije u timu i sa kupcima
Savladaš Engleski jezik (aktivno; u govoru i pisano)
Da ti je domać timski rad
Šta nudimo:
Osnovnu bruto platu koja zavisi od tvog iskustva, znanja, talenta (u okviru toga odradimo i tehnićki intervju) i dogovora
Do 500 EUR mesečne bruto nagrade u zavisnosti od uspeha kvartalnog poslovanja kompanije
Do 30% varijabilne lične mesečne nagrade za rezultate iznad očekivanja

Tražimo Medior/Senior developere (2-5) sa dosta iskustva u WordPress-u, WooCommerce-u, Javascriptu i Reactu.

‍

## Naša očekivanja:

*   Očekujemo da poseduješ dobar temelj opštih tehnologija za izradu web sajtova, osećaj za dizajn, debagovanje i rad u timu.
*   Očekujemo da imaš više od 3 godina iskustva u pravljenju web aplikacija i web sajtova.

*   Poznavanje frontend build alata (Grunt/Gulp, Webpack...).

*   Dobro poznavanje alata za kontrolu verzija koda (Git/GitHub).

*   Rada sa ACF blokovima kao i sa Gutenberg blokovima.
